doc.title: Dave Pell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Wearing many hats and the sidemen's resentment
summary: Pell says the band members resented him being player, contractor, producer and editor of their solos, but he was still one of the guys.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: A lot of times in the music business you need to wear a lot of hats I think.

I guess so. I always did and I kind of think the guys in the bands always resented it a little bit because I had so many hats on. Yeah I was playing with them but he is also the contractor and he is also making double what we’re getting paid, and he’s also running the record company and he’s also editing out our good solos and saving his good ones. So I always had a reaction from the guys, but I was still one of the guys enough to be able to get more out of them then the normal kind of record company or a producer.
From a musician’s standpoint, you maybe have a better handle on what’s really good than a non-musician.
